A character is only informative where at least one taxon scores 0 — an orthologous site located by both flanks and demonstrably empty. '?' means the site could not be placed and is not evidence of absence. Run the matrix under Dollo parsimony (eve_matrix.nex) rather than standard parsimony: insertions are effectively irreversible gains, losses are deletions.
